description: Anatomy of the z_D Q_beta gap. Decomposes the 337,429x apparent degradation into 1312x MISSING LADDER and 257x FUNCTIONAL (base to base); shows tr^z(Delta_S) = h^2/2 - z*h so Q_beta is nearly proportional to z and the published 0.168% was reachable only within 0.15% of the INADMISSIBLE z = 1; refutes the missing-normalisation hypothesis (Sum y_lam f^lam = 1 exactly at n = 3..12); and measures what D's two-row truncation kills in the binding Frobenius sum (A=4 keeps 0.043% of the dimension). Measures only.
